##### Project general facts

Buddha Club House is a premium-class residential complex by Avalon Development Bali, a company with over two decades of construction expertise and a growing international presence. This visionary project offers a collection of modern apartments in Canggu's most coveted Berawa district, designed for both sophisticated living and high-yield investment. Managed by the experienced Ribas Hotels Group, the development combines architectural refinement with professional hospitality management, ensuring both comfort and stable returns for discerning investors.

Residents are welcomed into a thoughtfully designed environment where every detail enhances daily life. The complex features an accessible rooftop oasis with an infinity pool, a sky bar, a restaurant with panoramic views, and an open-air cinema for unforgettable evenings. A unique meditation pyramid offers a dedicated space for energy restoration and inner balance. Additional amenities include underground parking, a cinema hall, and a modern co-working space, creating a complete lifestyle destination within one exceptional setting.

Each apartment at Buddha Club House is crafted with a focus on contemporary design and functional luxury. Modern one-bedroom layouts are thoughtfully arranged, with select units featuring private pools or jacuzzis for an added touch of exclusivity. Interiors are defined by clean lines, abundant natural light, and high-quality finishes that create a serene and inviting atmosphere. Every residence is designed to be a sanctuary of comfort, seamlessly blending style with practicality.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the prestigious Berawa district of Canggu within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents at the heart of Bali's most dynamic and sought-after coastal community. Berawa is renowned for its vibrant energy, world-class dining, boutique shopping, and some of the island's most popular beach clubs. The area perfectly balances modern convenience with tropical charm, attracting a discerning international crowd seeking both lifestyle and investment potential.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and lifestyle offerings. Just moments from the central beach, residents enjoy easy access to golden sands and legendary surf breaks, while a wealth of cafes, fitness centers, and cultural attractions are within easy reach. The neighborhood's well-developed infrastructure and growing reputation as a premier destination make it highly desirable for both short-term visitors and long-term residents.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the essence of contemporary island living, Canggu delivers an unmatched experience. Its unique blend of coastal beauty, thriving community, and world-class amenities has made it one of Bali's most sought-after addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of tropical living, vibrant, connected and effortlessly inspiring.
